youtube_title: Calf Cramp At 3 Am? Do This | Body Fix #24 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #24. 3 AM, sudden CALF CRAMP, and you wake up screaming?
B is right. Pull your toes TOWARDS you, stretch the calf. The cramp releases.
A cramp = a muscle suddenly tightening. Often no clear cause, more after exercise.
Fix: Walk a bit, massage, stretch your calf before bed, stay hydrated.
Red flags: Every night, swollen red warm leg, or numbness? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Leg cramps
